invariants.rationale: The method relies on accessing multiple style fields; style must not be null for these accesses to be safe.
The return value at the end is style.fontColor, which should be null or a Color instance to be valid.

invariants.expression: !isPressed() || (style.downFontColor == null && style.checkedDownFontColor == null && !isChecked()) || (style.downFontColor != null || (isChecked() && style.checkedDownFontColor != null))
invariants.rationale: If isPressed() is true, the method returns a non-null down-related fontColor if available.

invariants.expression: !isOver() || (!isChecked() && (style.overFontColor != null || style.checkedOverFontColor == null)) || (isChecked() && (style.checkedOverFontColor != null || style.overFontColor == null))
invariants.rationale: On isOver(), the return prioritizes the checkedOverFontColor if checked, else overFontColor if not checked.
If the button is focused, a focusedFontColor or checkedFocusedFontColor must be available when checked.
